atoms.name: Language hierarchy
atoms.one_line: Regular ⊂ DCFL ⊂ CFL ⊂ CSL ⊂ recursive ⊂ RE, every inclusion strict.

atoms.name: Classify by memory
atoms.one_line: Finite memory is regular, one stack is CF, two comparisons or a copy are CSL; unary non-periodic is not CF.

atoms.name: Pumping lemma for regular languages
atoms.one_line: Long strings split xyz with |xy| ≤ p and |y| ≥ 1; it refutes regularity but never proves it.

atoms.name: Pumping lemma for CFLs
atoms.one_line: Long strings split uvxyz with |vxy| ≤ p and |vy| ≥ 1; a short window misses a letter group.

atoms.name: Closure of regular languages
atoms.one_line: Union, intersection, complement, difference, reversal, prefix and suffix are closed; infinite union is not.

atoms.name: Closure of other classes
atoms.one_line: CFL: not intersection or complement. DCFL: complement yes, union no. RE: not complement. Recursive: complement yes.

atoms.name: Decision properties
atoms.one_line: Regular: all decidable. CFG: membership, emptiness, finiteness yes; equivalence, universality, ambiguity no.

atoms.name: Myhill–Nerode and drift
atoms.one_line: Infinitely many distinguishable prefixes mean not regular; counts that stay close together are regular.
